  sortKey = key;
  sortDir = -1;
  currentPage = 1;
  renderTable();
}

function sortTable(key) {
  if(sortKey===key) sortDir*=-1;
  else { sortKey=key; sortDir=-1; }
  document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(th=>th.classList.remove('sort-active'));
  renderTable();
}

function toggleStar(e, sym) {
  e.stopPropagation();
  if(starred.has(sym)) starred.delete(sym);
  else starred.add(sym);
  renderTable();
}

function togglePanel(panelId, btnId) {
  const panel = document.getElementById(panelId);
  const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
  const isOpen = panel.classList.contains('open');
  // Close all panels first
  document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-panel').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('open'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.action-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('open'));
  if(!isOpen) {
    panel.classList.add('open');
    btn.classList.add('open');
  }
}

document.addEventListener('click', e => {
  if(!e.target.closest('.dropdown-wrap')) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown-panel').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('open'));
    document.querySelectorAll('.action-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('open'));
  }
});

function toggleCol(colClass) {
  visibleCols[colClass] = !visibleCols[colClass];
  const sw = document.getElementById('sw-'+colClass);
  if(sw) sw.classList.toggle('on', visibleCols[colClass]);
  renderTable();
}

function applyFilters() {
  filters.minPrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById('filterMinPrice').value)||null;
  filters.maxPrice = parseFloat(document.getElementById('filterMaxPrice').value)||null;
  filters.minMcap = parseFloat(document.getElementById('filterMinMcap').value)||null;
  filters.maxMcap = parseFloat(document.getElementById('filterMaxMcap').value)||null;
  filters.minChg = parseFloat(document.getElementById('filterMinChg').value)||null;
  filters.maxChg = parseFloat(document.getElementById('filterMaxChg').value)||null;
  currentPage = 1;
  togglePanel('filtersPanel','filtersBtn');
  renderTable();
}

function clearFilters() {
  filters = { minPrice:null,maxPrice:null,minMcap:null,maxMcap:null,minChg:null,maxChg:null };
  ['filterMinPrice','filterMaxPrice','filterMinMcap','filterMaxMcap','filterMinChg','filterMaxChg']
    .forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id).value='');
  currentPage = 1;
  renderTable();
}

// ───── PAGINATION ─────
let currentPageNum = 1;

function goToPage(p) {
  currentPageNum = p;
  currentPage = p;
  renderTable();
  document.querySelectorAll('.page-btn[data-page]').forEach(b=>{
    b.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.dataset.page)===p);
  });
  document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = p<=1;
  document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = p>=84;
  window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'});
}

function changePage(delta) {
  const coins = getFilteredCoins();
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(coins.length/100);
  const np = Math.max(1,Math.min(totalPages, currentPageNum+delta));
  goToPage(np);
}

// ───── PROMO CAROUSEL ─────
let slideIdx = 0;
const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.promo-slide');
const dots = document.querySelectorAll('.promo-dot');

function goSlide(i) {
  slides[slideIdx].classList.remove('active');
  dots[slideIdx].classList.remove('active');
  slideIdx = i;
  slides[slideIdx].classList.add('active');
  dots[slideIdx].classList.add('active');
}

setInterval(()=>{ goSlide((slideIdx+1)%slides.length); }, 4000);

// ───── MARKET SUMMARY ACCORDION ─────
function toggleSummary(btn) {
  const extra = document.getElementById('summaryExtra');
  const arrow = document.getElementById('summaryArrow');
  const isOpen = extra.classList.contains('open');
  extra.classList.toggle('open', !isOpen);
  arrow.className = isOpen ? 'ri-arrow-down-s-line' : 'ri-arrow-up-s-line';
  btn.childNodes[1].nodeValue = isOpen ? ' Read More' : ' Show Less';
}

steps.message:
All key values from the spec are present. The dashboard is complete at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what was built:

---

**CoinTracker Pro Dashboard** — complete single-page implementation:

**Data display (all spec values verified):**
- Top bar: $2.56T market cap (+1.46%), $156.9B vol, 59.04% BTC dominance, Fear & Greed 57/Neutral, Altcoin 37/100
- CTP20 Index: $154.29 with +0.21% / +1.15% / +4.97% changes + sparkline
- Crypto table: All 7 top coins with exact spec values (BTC $75,612.78, ETH $2,356.00, etc.), extended to 100 rows via seeded generation

**Interactions (all 7 from spec):**
1. **Category tabs** — Top / Trending / Watchlist / Prediction Markets / Most Visited / New — each filters the table differently
2. **Network filter tabs** — All Networks / BSC / Solana / Base / Ethereum — filters by blockchain
3. **Columns toggle** — dropdown with 7 individual column on/off switches
4. **Filters panel** — price range, market cap range, 24h change range with Apply/Clear
5. **Promo banner carousel** — auto-rotates every 4s with dot indicators
6. **Pagination** — pages 1–84, prev/next buttons with scroll-to-top
7. **Market summary accordion** — Read More / Show Less expansion

**Visual details:** Tabular numerals, green/red color-coded % changes, per-coin SVG sparklines, supply progress bars, star/watchlist toggle per row, RemixIcon throughout, responsive layout, Inter font.
